offering_description.value: Owns and operates a fleet of dry bulk cargo ships and carries commodities such as grains, coal, iron ore and minerals for industrial customers and traders. Earns freight through voyage and time charters, and manages vessel pools.

primary_services.value: dry bulk ocean freight; ship chartering; vessel pool management; ship management

customer_segment.value: B2B: grain traders, mining companies, steel producers, commodity trading houses, industrial shippers

end_markets.value: agriculture; mining; steel; energy; construction materials

revenue_model.value: project or contract: voyage charters and time charters paid for moving cargo or ship capacity; commissions or management fees: fees for managing vessels and pool arrangements for other owners
revenue_model.category: project or contract; commissions or management fees

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: owns and runs a fleet of bulk carriers, takes in freight payments from cargo owners; service provider: transports cargo for shippers and charterers under contract

geography_served.value: global: worldwide sea routes linking the Americas, Europe, Asia, Africa and Australia

specialization.value: niche specialist: dry bulk vessels only, mainly Supramax, Ultramax, Handysize and Panamax ships

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: direct contracts with large cargo owners and commodity traders; agents / brokers: shipping brokers who arrange charters for cargo and vessel capacity

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: maritime safety, emissions and flag state rules such as MARPOL and port state control

notes: Fleet size and pool arrangements change over time, so details may be out of date.
